indications_and_usage: Uses Helps decrease bacteria on hands.
warnings: Warnings For external use only. When using the product Avoid contact with eyes. In case of Contact, Flush with Water. Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical attention or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
when_using: When using the product Avoid contact with eyes. In case of Contact, Flush with Water.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical attention or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
dosage_and_administration: Directions From pump bottle, apply onto wet hands. Lather and rinse thoroughly.
storage_and_handling: Other Information Store at room temperature.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients Water (Aqua), Lauramidopropylamine Oxide, Glycerin, Cetrimonium Chloride, Sodium Chloride, Cocamide MEA, PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate, Fragrance (Parfum), Citric Acid, Tetrasodium EDTA, Sodium Sulfate, Methylchloroisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Blue 1 (CI42090), Red 33 (CI 17200).
